description: Decision C8 (the validators' liveness check; PRICING-PLAN.md section 11, RESERVATION-DESIGN.md section 2): the message a running order's trustedzone posts every minute to the members that follow the order, the text its task wallet signs and the EIP-191 digest, the JSON body, POST /validator/live and its answers; the follower count and the draw from the order id; the window a message is taken in and the judging of a minute; the follower-to-follower query and signed reply over the peer channel (MSG_LIVE_QUERY 7, MSG_LIVE_REPLY 8). The two messages are signed by the task wallet of result-v5.json's session example for its order; the node and the minute (t0 / 60) are capability-record.json's, whose validator signs the reply.

parameters.rule: the Liveness parameters of every deployment row (ethernity-cas pox_client.rs TESTNET_LIVENESS): a message every 60 s, five consecutive confirmed misses, 51 % of the seated set and at least three followers. minute is floor(unix seconds / 60) whatever periodSecs says.

message.signedTextRule: the tag, the order id in decimal, the minute (floor(unix seconds / 60) on the sender's clock) in decimal, the node (the DP request's dproc) as 0x and 40 lower-case hex digits whatever case the body spells it in, and 1 for the order's last message or 0 otherwise, joined with |; no terminator.
message.digestRule: EIP-191 personal sign: keccak256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" || decimal byte length of the text || the UTF-8 text); ethers hashMessage / signMessage, the trustedzone's walletSigner.signMessage, ethernity-cas transcript_rows::personal_sign_digest.

signature.scheme: secp256k1 ECDSA by the order's task wallet (the wallet its etny-sw row attested), RFC 6979 deterministic k, low-s, recoverable
signature.serializedRule: 65 bytes r || s || v as 0x-prefixed 130 hex characters, v the recovery id plus 27 (27 or 28); this is the body's sig field

body.rule: a JSON object of at most 1024 bytes with exactly these five keys: order the order id as a decimal string (digits only, not empty, at most u64), minute a non-negative integer (a JSON number, at most u64), node 0x followed by 40 hex digits in either case, final a boolean, sig 0x followed by 130 hex digits. Any other body, key set, type or spelling is refused with 400 (liveness.rs parse_message).

message.sender: the order's trustedzone, to each member that follows the order, over the REST channel to that member's REST interface (plain HTTP/1.1, the one GET /validator/time is served on; the message's and the answers' signatures carry the integrity): every 60 s from its idle points and from a timer while the payload runs, and one last message with final true once it has signed the result.

taskWallet.source: result-v5.json session.taskWalletPrivateKey, the task wallet of its session example (order 4101)
taskWallet.swRow: a member follows the order once the order's etny-sw row names this wallet: key etny-sw, value v1:<orderId>:<taskWallet>:<sigDerHex>, the trustedzone's ECDSA secp384r1 / SHA-256 DER signature over etny-sw|<orderId>|<taskWallet>; the DP request's dproc is the node every message must name.

examples.rule: the minute example is a message of a running order; the final example, one minute later with final true, is its last: the follow ends at it and no later minute is judged. The minute flag and the final flag are in the signed text, so a message moved to another minute or with the flag flipped recovers to another address.

livenessRsTestVector.rule: the vector the liveness.rs tests hold (KEY, WALLET, NODE, MINUTE, DIGEST, SIG, SIG_FINAL), reproduced here with ethers; the generator refuses to write the fixture when they differ.

endpoint.checks: in this order: the body parses as a message (else 400); the member follows the order (else 404); the message names the order's node (else 403); the minute is inside the window around the member's clock (else 403); the signature recovers to the order's task wallet (else 403). A refused message is not recorded.

answers.when: the message is recorded for the minute it names; final is true when it was the order's last message, which ends the follow

answers.body: {"error":"the message has exactly the keys order, minute, node, final and sig"}
answers.when: the body is not a message: not JSON, not an object, another key set, a wrong type or spelling, or more than 1024 bytes; the reason is parse_message's

answers.body: {"error":"order 4101 is not followed by this member"}
answers.when: this member follows no such order: it is not among the order's followers, the order's etny-sw row is not read yet, or the follow ended (a final message, the order closed, its settlementOutcome set)

answers.body: {"error":"the message names another node than the order's, 0x470d8b388f4a0ae6bd512b74038c7e87957bb8fe"}
answers.when: the node differs from the order's DP request's dproc

answers.body: {"error":"the minute is outside the window around this member's minute 29362080"}
answers.when: the minute is more than 2 behind or more than 1 ahead of the member's floor(unix seconds / 60)

answers.body: {"error":"signed by 0x19e7e376e7c213b7e7e7e46cc70a5dd086daff2a, not by the order's task wallet"}
answers.when: the signature recovers to a wallet other than the order's task wallet; a signature that recovers to no address answers {"error":"the signature recovers to no wallet"}

followers.countRule: k = min(n, max(3, ceil(0.51 x n))) over n seated members (liveness.rs follower_count; min_followers 3, target_percent 51)
followers.drawRule: the seated addresses sorted ascending as 20-byte values with duplicates dropped; start = keccak256(uint256 orderId) mod n; the followers are the k members at indexes (start + j) mod n for j = 0..k-1, in that order; every member and the trustedzone draw the same set from the same seated set whatever order they hold it in.

example.hashRule: keccak256 of the order id as a 32-byte big-endian unsigned integer

window.rule: a message is taken when its minute is at most 2 behind and at most 1 ahead of the receiver's floor(unix seconds / 60): minute + 2 >= now and minute <= now + 1; a minute further off is refused with 403 (Reject::OutsideWindow).

judging.dueRule: a follow starts in the minute the member read the order's etny-sw row; from the first unjudged minute, minute M is judged once now_minute >= M + 2, at most 4 minutes per tick, each once. A minute this member did not receive is asked of the other followers over the peer channel (MSG_LIVE_QUERY) until one answers received; a minute no follower received is a confirmed miss.
judging.missesRule: misses are counted only after the first received minute, so an enclave that never sent is never voted on; a received minute (here or at a follower asked) resets the count; at 5 consecutive confirmed misses, with no final message, the member sends CasCapacity.voteLiveness(orderId) once (after a pre-flight; where the row votes nothing or names no CasCapacity the verdict is logged); the quorum calls invalidateLive through the settlement contract. The follow ends at the final message, when the order stops running or when its settlementOutcome is set.

peer.channel: the mutually attested CAS peer connection between two seated members (peer_channel::send_live_query); the query is unsigned, the reply is signed by the answering member's wallet since it is counted toward an on-chain vote. A reply that answers another order or minute, or recovers to another wallet than the follower asked, counts for nothing (liveness.rs verify_reply). A member answers received false for a minute it does not hold and for an order it does not follow.

layout.encoding: u8, 1 received or 0 not; any other value refuses the reply

reply.digestRule: keccak256("ethernity-cas/live-reply/v1" || order uint64 big-endian || minute uint64 big-endian || received u8), 44 preimage bytes; signed directly, with no EIP-191 prefix.

signature.vRule: the last byte is the recovery id plus 27 (27 or 28, ethers) or the bare recovery id (0 or 1, the CAS's cas_identity::sign_recoverable); the verifier (validator_gov::recover_address) subtracts 27 from a byte of 27 or more, so both forms recover to the same address

reply.signerSource: capability-record.json validator.privateKey, the validator identity of its time statements
